description:
This Java class defines the 'Tag' entity used in the book project to represent user-defined labels for books, including fields for tags' id and name, and a bidirectional many-to-many relationship with the 'Book' entity.
It includes annotations for persistence mapping, JSON serialization control, Lombok-generated methods, and licensing and documentation comments.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Entity class representing a tag for categorizing books. Contains a unique ID, a name, and a set of associated books.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Constructor to create a Tag instance with a specified name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equality check to compare tags based on their name.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode to compute hash based on the tag's name.
